about: Programs an admin may add to an agent that runs shell commands (enum). Reviewed in code, shipped read-only. Every entry is RECONNAISSANCE ONLY: it observes, it does not exploit, brute-force, upload, execute remotely or change anything on a target. 'extra_denied' are argument patterns refused for that program ON TOP of the agent's own denied patterns and the scope check (every command must still name an in-scope IP). Exploitation tooling is deliberately absent and belongs to a separate, separately-approved project.
